providers.name: YouTube Data API v3
notes: All endpoints share the host https://www.googleapis.com and the path prefix /youtube/v3.
Every list method requires a part parameter. part selects which top-level groups of properties (snippet, contentDetails, statistics, ...) appear in each resource; unrequested parts are absent.
Public data can be read with an API key (key query parameter). Write operations and private data require OAuth 2.0 user authorization.

Quota (getting-started page, verified 2026-10-17): 100 search.list calls per day in a separate Search Queries bucket, plus 10,000 units per day for all other endpoints combined. The list methods in this library cost 1 unit per call.
Count statistics (viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, subscriberCount, videoCount) are unsigned long values serialized as JSON strings; convert before doing arithmetic.
dislikeCount has been private since December 13, 2021, and favoriteCount is deprecated (always 0).
Video durations use ISO 8601 duration strings such as PT15M33S.
standard and maxres thumbnails are not available for every video.

endpoints.title: Search: list
endpoints.description: Returns a collection of search results (videos, channels and/or playlists) that match the query parameters. Each result identifies the matching resource and includes a snippet. Quota: search calls come from a separate bucket of 100 calls per day. Results sorted by date rely on the search index, so new content may be delayed or missing; the documentation recommends playlistItems.list for a channel's recent uploads.

endpoints.title: CommentThreads: list
endpoints.description: Returns comment threads that match the request: the threads on one video, all threads related to a channel, or specific threads by ID. Each thread contains its top-level comment and, if the replies part is requested, some of its replies. The replies list may contain only a subset of the replies (it is complete only when its length equals snippet.totalReplyCount); use comments.list with parentId to retrieve all replies. Up to 100 threads per page; more pages are reached with nextPageToken. If the video has disabled comments, the request fails with 403 commentsDisabled. Quota cost: 1 unit.

endpoints.title: Playlists: insert
endpoints.description: Creates a playlist on the authorized user's channel and returns the new playlist resource, including its id. Requires OAuth 2.0 with a write scope (youtube, youtube.force-ssl or youtubepartner); an API key alone is not enough. The request body is a playlist resource: snippet.title is required; snippet.description, status.privacyStatus, snippet.defaultLanguage and localizations can be set. A playlist resource has no list of videos: videos are added afterwards with playlistItems.insert. Quota cost: 50 units (write operation).

endpoints.description: Adds one resource (for example a video) to a playlist and returns the new playlist item. Each call adds a single item.
